category_title: Child with ASD, ADHD, and Specific Learning Disability exhibiting significant behavioral resistance to reading instruction
scenario_title: Developing reading automaticity through functional activities
minimal_context: Sam is working one-on-one with an interventionist to sound out words on treasure hunt clues to find a prize.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the first clue for our treasure hunt. Let's sound out these words to find out where the prize is.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of his chair and begins roaming the classroom instead of looking at the clue.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back to your seat and look at the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I don't want to read it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to read the sentence to get the next clue.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the clue on the floor and begins having a meltdown, screaming and completely refusing to participate in the instructional task.)
